title: Start by generating a controlled product reference in Seedream 5.0 Pro (e.g., a…
content:
Start by generating a controlled product reference in Seedream 5.0 Pro (e.g., a clean black cap with the BytePlus logo) before moving to Seedance 2.5 so you can integrate it consistently into later sequences.  
Use a product-mockup prompt specifying pure white background, slightly angled front view, studio lighting, realistic shadows, photorealistic rendering, crisp focus, and “logo faithfully reproduced, clean and clearly visible” to create a clean reference asset for Seedance.
tips:
Start by generating a controlled product reference in Seedream 5.0 Pro (e.g., a clean black cap with the BytePlus logo) before moving to Seedance 2.5 so you can integrate it consistently into later sequences.  
Use a product-mockup prompt specifying pure white background, slightly angled front view, studio lighting, realistic shadows, photorealistic rendering, crisp focus, and “logo faithfully reproduced, clean and clearly visible” to create a clean reference asset for Seedance.

es.content:
Empieza generando una referencia controlada del producto en Seedream 5.0 Pro (por ejemplo, una gorra negra limpia con el logo de BytePlus) antes de pasar a Seedance 2.5, para que puedas integrarla de forma consistente en secuencias posteriores.  
Usa un prompt de mockup de producto que especifique fondo blanco puro, vista frontal ligeramente en ángulo, iluminación de estudio, sombras realistas, renderizado fotorrealista, enfoque nítido y “logo faithfully reproduced, clean and clearly visible” para crear un asset de referencia limpio para Seedance.

fr.content:
Commencez par générer une référence produit contrôlée dans Seedream 5.0 Pro (par exemple, une casquette noire épurée avec le logo BytePlus) avant de passer à Seedance 2.5, afin de pouvoir l’intégrer de manière cohérente dans les séquences ultérieures.  
Utilisez un prompt de product mockup précisant un fond blanc pur, une vue de face légèrement inclinée, un éclairage de studio, des ombres réalistes, un rendu photoréaliste, une mise au point nette, et « logo faithfully reproduced, clean and clearly visible » pour créer un asset de référence propre pour Seedance.

ja.content:
まず Seedream 5.0 Pro で制御された製品リファレンスを生成します（例: BytePlus ロゴ入りのきれいな黒いキャップ）。その後、Seedance 2.5 に進むことで、後続のシーケンスに一貫して組み込めるようにします。  
Seedance 用のクリーンな参照アセットを作成するために、pure white background、slightly angled front view、studio lighting、realistic shadows、photorealistic rendering、crisp focus、そして “logo faithfully reproduced, clean and clearly visible” を指定した product-mockup prompt を使用してください。

ko.content:
먼저 Seedream 5.0 Pro에서 제어된 제품 레퍼런스(예: BytePlus 로고가 들어간 깔끔한 검은색 캡)를 생성한 다음, Seedance 2.5로 넘어가면 이후 시퀀스에 일관되게 통합할 수 있습니다.  
Seedance용 깔끔한 레퍼런스 에셋을 만들기 위해, pure white background, slightly angled front view, studio lighting, realistic shadows, photorealistic rendering, crisp focus, 그리고 “logo faithfully reproduced, clean and clearly visible”를 지정한 product-mockup prompt를 사용하세요.

pt.content:
Comece gerando uma referência controlada do produto no Seedream 5.0 Pro (por exemplo, um boné preto limpo com o logo da BytePlus) antes de passar para o Seedance 2.5, para que você possa integrá-lo de forma consistente em sequências posteriores.  
Use um prompt de mockup de produto especificando fundo branco puro, vista frontal levemente angulada, iluminação de estúdio, sombras realistas, renderização fotorrealista, foco nítido e “logo faithfully reproduced, clean and clearly visible” para criar um asset de referência limpo para o Seedance.

zh.content:
先在 Seedream 5.0 Pro 中生成一个受控的产品参考图（例如，一顶带有 BytePlus 标志的干净黑色帽子），然后再进入 Seedance 2.5，这样你就可以在后续序列中将其一致地整合进去。  
使用一个 product-mockup prompt，指定纯白背景、略微倾斜的正面视角、studio lighting、真实阴影、photorealistic rendering、清晰对焦，以及“logo faithfully reproduced, clean and clearly visible”，以便为 Seedance 创建一个干净的参考素材。
